cohort: 1,671,337 pregnant women in Ontario, Canada, from 2002/03 to 2014/15
finding: First Nations women had a higher prevalence of preexisting diabetes and gestational diabetes than other women in Ontario and experienced higher rates of adverse maternal outcomes, highlighting disparities in care.
mod_finding: First Nations women with preexisting or gestational diabetes had higher rates of cesarean delivery compared to other women in Ontario.
